title: FlashArb
tagline: Stop losing to MEV. Start earning from it. Cross-chain arbitrage meets profit sharing
description: FlashArb democratizes MEV by detecting cross-chain arbitrage opportunities during your regular swaps and sharing 75% of the profits directly with you. Using Uniswap V4 hooks, Pyth oracles, and World ID verification, we eliminate MEV extraction while rewarding users for providing liquidity to the ecosystem.
how_its_made:
Uniswap V4 Hook Architecture:
Built as a native Uniswap V4 hook that intercepts swaps to detect MEV opportunities in real-time using beforeSwap and afterSwap callbacks.

Cross-Chain Price Detection:
Integrates Pyth Network oracles to compare prices across 5 Sepolia testnets (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Unichain) and identify profitable arbitrage gaps.

Flash Loan Execution:
Uses Uniswap V4's native unlockCallback for gasless flash loans, executing cross-chain arbitrage when opportunities exceed 2% profit threshold.

Sybil Resistance:
World ID verification with 1-hour rate limiting prevents abuse while ensuring fair profit distribution (75% user, 25% protocol).

Smart Profit Sharing
Automated on-chain profit distribution with MEV score tracking, gas compensation for failed trades, and transparent earnings dashboard.
